europe_now.title: Wildfires spread across France and Greece
europe_now.summary: Wildfires have expanded across regions of southern France and central Greece, prompting large-scale evacuations. Firefighting crews are working to contain the blazes while authorities assess damage and assist displaced residents.

europe_now.title: Migration surge at Spain's Ceuta enclave
europe_now.summary: A notable increase in migrant arrivals has been observed at Spain's Ceuta enclave, leading to heightened humanitarian concerns. Spanish authorities have installed barriers and requested EU support, prompting an emergency EU meeting to address the situation.

top_stories.title: European wildfire response and evacuations
top_stories.summary: Firefighters have been battling blazes in southern France and central Greece, leading to the evacuation of thousands of residents. Authorities report that many evacuees have been allowed to return home as conditions improve, while efforts continue to contain the fires.

top_stories.title: Ceuta migration surge prompts EU action
top_stories.summary: Spain has installed a floating barrier in Ceuta to manage a recent influx of migrants arriving from North Africa. The European Union has convened an emergency meeting to discuss the situation and coordinate humanitarian assistance.
